selection_criteria.interior_persistent: >= 2 of 3 exploratory seeds individually satisfy classify_regime's interior-persistent criterion; ties broken by more passing seeds, then lowest (source, point_id) -- never by outcome preference
selection_criteria.oscillatory_or_intermittent: >= 1 exploratory seed satisfies the oscillatory criterion; if none exists across both batches, fall back to intermittent under the same rule; if neither exists, record that no nonstationary candidate qualified
selection_criteria.near_collapse: smallest |mean_occupancy - depletion_threshold| among non-collapsed points, excluding points already selected above -- ecological proximity to transition, not a preferred behavioral outcome

exclusion_rules: selection never reads social co-operation, sanctioning, or any social-game statistic
selection never compares a point to the dissertation's three governance trajectories
selection never reads any causal-intervention or perturbation-recovery result (none exist yet at this point in the milestone's work-package order)
once selected and written to this file, a candidate is not replaced because its later causal/confirmation results are disappointing

interior_persistent.eligibility_rule: >= 2 of 3 exploratory seeds satisfy classify_regime's interior-persistent criterion

nonstationary.eligibility_rule: no point satisfied the oscillatory criterion (0 of 48 points searched across both batches had any oscillatory seed); falling back to intermittent per the milestone's explicit instruction not to manufacture an oscillatory candidate -- >= 1 of 3 exploratory seeds satisfy classify_regime's intermittent criterion

near_collapse.eligibility_rule: smallest |mean_occupancy - depletion_threshold(0.05)| among points with mean_occupancy > depletion_threshold, i.e. ecologically closest to the collapse boundary without having already collapsed -- selected by proximity to transition, not by any behavioral or social co-operation outcome

rejected_candidates.reason: eligible but not selected -- lower n_interior_persistent_seeds or tie-broken by (source, point_id) order, not by outcome preference

primary_and_secondary_outcomes: seed-level label distribution and agreement (Work Package D)
post-burn-in mean/minimum/terminal occupancy, trend, depletion/abundance duration (Work Package D)
causal-intervention continuous paired effects vs. 7 counterfactual conditions (Work Packages F/G)
fitness-stream sensitivity at the primary candidate (Work Package H)
perturbation-recovery eligibility and recovery quality (Work Packages J/K)
